title: Chapter 45 — The Interior Designer and Architect
intro: The prestige specifiers — luxury-tier projects and the support model.

sections.title: The Prestige Channel
sections.content:
Interior designers and architects work on high-end projects where appliance selection is part of a broader design vision. These relationships produce the largest tickets and the longest timelines.

Support them with expertise, patience, and the understanding that their client's experience reflects on them. Make them look good and they will bring you every project.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating prestige channel relationships, ask:

Does the salesperson understand the design process and timeline?
Do they support the designer's vision — or push their own agenda?
Are they positioned as a trusted resource — or just another vendor?
